name: shelf
description: Local-first shelf for agent-generated HTML: CLI, desktop app, and PWA.

scripts.build: npm run build -w ui && npm run build -w cli
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w cli && npm run test -w ui && npm run test -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w cli && npm run typecheck -w ui && npm run typecheck -w web
